/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import Levenshtein, json, os

def readfa(p): return ''.join(open(p).read().splitlines()[1:])
h=readfa('NM_000193.4.fasta')[341:641]
products={}
for line in open('species_products.jsonl'):
 j=json.loads(line)
 for t in j.get('transcripts',[]): products[t['accession_version']]=(j.get('taxname'),t)
seqs={}
for acc in ['XM_001147185.7','XM_001106515.5','XM_034965340.4','XM_034650041.1','XM_022576607.2']:
 tax,t=products[acc]; s=readfa(acc+'.fasta'); cds=int(t['cds']['range'][0]['begin']); e1=int(t['genomic_locations'][0]['exons'][0]['end'])-int(t['genomic_locations'][0]['exons'][0]['begin'])+1; seqs[tax]=s[cds-1:e1]
seqs['Indri indri']=''
seqs['Semnopithecus johnii']=''
order=['Pan troglodytes','Macaca mulatta','Pan paniscus','Indri indri','Semnopithecus johnii','Ailuropoda melanoleuca','Delphinapterus leucas']
print([Levenshtein.distance(h,seqs[s]) for s in order])
print(','.join(str(Levenshtein.distance(h,seqs[s])) for s in order))
PY"
